ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Articles L561-2 to L561-12 of the Code monétaire et financier (implementing EU AML Directive 5th), Decree No. 2021-1344 of 22 October 2021 establishing the beneficial ownership register

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association or Certificate of Incorporation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening for PEP status, OFAC sanctions, UN sanctions lists, and French domestic sanctions using automated compliance software and manual review; UBO source of funds and wealth verification required

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Mandatory use of French language and Latin alphabet; foreign names subject to French phonetic transliteration rules
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Names infringing existing trademarks or similar to protected entities
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Name rejection by greffe triggers 2-month appeal period to the Tribunal de Commerce; further administrative appeal to the Ministry of Economy and Finance available for procedural errors

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for e-commerce and non-regulated activities; registered office must ensure effective communication and tax compliance, virtual addresses accepted with proper verification
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (estimated 5-10% for standard incorporations without red flags); unannounced inspections primarily conducted for AML/CFT or tax substance verification

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Code de commerce (French Commercial Code), articles L. 223-1 et seq. (Sociétés à Responsabilité Limitée)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce du siège social
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Acte de constitution de la société
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum capital of €1; no escrow account required
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The Board of Directors resolves unanimously as follows: (1) The Company subscribes to the share capital of EUR 1,000 by issuing 1,000 shares of EUR 1 par value each to the subscribers listed in the share subscription agreements; (2) The registered office is established at [Insert full address]; (3) [Name of Managing Director] is appointed as Managing Director and [Name of Deputy] as Deputy Managing Director; (4) The Articles of Association are adopted in the form presented and the Managing Director is authorized to proceed with filing the incorporation documents with the competent commercial registry and to open the company bank account. This resolution is adopted on [date].

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary or directly to Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Shareholders prepare and sign the Articles of Association detailing share capital, corporate object, registered office, and director appointments. All shareholders execute the document.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Provide additional clarifications or amendments if queried by the registry

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company bank account or escrow service
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Subscribers remit the full share capital via bank transfer or as agreed; obtain and retain proof of payment for filing.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Rectify payment documentation if incomplete or disputed

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit signed Articles to a notary for authentication and issuance of the official acte de notoriété confirming compliance.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Address any discrepancies identified during notary review

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce via guichet-entreprises.fr or direct submission
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Acte de Constitution, authenticated Articles, and supporting documents online or in person; obtain SIREN and SIRET numbers.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to any registry query or request for additional information within the statutory deadline

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable for online retail activities
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: N/A - No operational or manufacturing permit required

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministère de la Transition écologique et de la Cohésion des territoires
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No physical operations; no wastewater, VOCs, or waste handling applicable

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not required for purely online retail operations; no fire safety or structural inspections needed

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) via official portal impots.gouv.fr
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: French SARL obtains SIREN/SIRET from INSEE upon incorporation, registers for tax identification number and VAT number with DGFiP if turnover exceeds threshold, and complies with corporate tax filing obligations
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box elections; small businesses may elect micro-entreprise regime or other simplified taxation under Code général des impôts

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time e-invoicing (e-facturation) for B2B transactions with API integration to fiscal authorities and digital time-stamping requirements

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT rate on goods exported outside EU or services performed outside EU, subject to proof of export and non-EU destination
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or equivalent transport document
Inward Remittance Certificate (IRC) or proof of payment
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Retrospective clawback of zero-rated VAT with penalties up to 80% of VAT due, plus interest and potential criminal sanctions for fraudulent declarations

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France operates under full capital account convertibility and current account convertibility pursuant to EU Treaty provisions and IMF Article VIII. The euro is freely convertible without restrictions on repatriation of profits, dividends, or capital. Profit remittance to non-resident shareholders is permitted following standard corporate tax filing, beneficial ownership verification via RCS extracts, and FATCA/CRS reporting; no capital controls or prior approval required for legitimate business transactions below de minimis thresholds.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender or conversion of export proceeds in France. International sales receipts (including online retail of hydroponics equipment) may be retained in foreign currency accounts or converted at spot rates without statutory timeline or ratio obligations. Voluntary surrender is encouraged for liquidity optimization via Banque de France facilities; statistical reporting via customs declarations or tax authorities applies only if goods cross borders, with no fixed conversion ratios mandated.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: High feasibility for digital EMIs via licensed platforms such as Stripe and PayPal, subject to French AML/TRACFIN compliance, VAT registration under MOSS regime for cross-border supplies, and potential licensing requirements for high-value or regulated goods categories. Offshore digital EMIs require local bank sponsorship or partnership agreements; direct offshore issuance is prohibited without Banque de France authorization.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote KYC and company incorporation via online portals or video verification permitted for standard French SARL onboarding under Banque de France guidelines; however, directors or authorized signatories must attend physical branch interviews or provide notarized documents for initial account opening, especially for non-resident directors or transactions exceeding €50,000. Full remote opening restricted for complex structures or high-risk jurisdictions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership exceeding 25% held by non-resident entities without verified source of funds
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: RCS extract, passport or national ID copies, proof of address, and bank reference letters confirming legitimate commercial activity

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Monthly transaction volume exceeding €10,000 without documented commercial purpose
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial invoices, purchase orders, tax returns (TVA), and correspondence demonstrating alignment with online retail of garden equipment business

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctioned country exposure or PEP involvement
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Enhanced due diligence file including adverse media screening, source of wealth statements, and legal opinions on ownership chain

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound capital injections routed via SWIFT MT103 wires using purpose code 'EQUITY CONTRIBUTION' or 'CAPITAL INJECTION' to euro-denominated IBAN accounts at French banks. Verification protocols require SIREN/SIRET validation, beneficial ownership certificate (extract from RCS), director identification, and tax ID confirmation. Non-resident injections processed through correspondent banking networks with dual verification by compliance and treasury teams; no prior central bank approval needed for standard equity contributions.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade disbursements cleared primarily through SWIFT MT103 for supplier payments and Commercial Letters of Credit (LCs) where trade finance facilities are utilized. For online retail operations, payments to international suppliers use correspondent banking rails with proper purpose codes such as 'GOODS PURCHASE' or 'TRADE SETTLEMENT'. Platforms like Stripe handle customer-side settlements; supplier disbursements require matching commercial invoices and proof of goods receipt.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Forward FX contracts for hedging EUR exposure on import payments
Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) for USD/EUR pairs on international supplier contracts
Currency swaps for multi-currency liquidity management and cross-border cash pooling
Interest rate swaps combined with FX for comprehensive treasury risk mitigation

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return and accounting statements (liasse fiscale IS Form 2065 with 2050-series annexes)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a 31 December year-end: no later than the third business day following 1 May; for any other closing date: within three months of the close of the financial year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing surcharge of 5% of assessed corporate tax (minimum EUR 250), plus EUR 100 per missing mandatory annex, increased to EUR 250 after a formal notice; monthly late-payment interest of 0.45%; 40% surcharge in cases of bad faith; no impact on strike-off while a valid tax address is maintained

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Dépôt des comptes annuels (annual accounts filing at the commercial registry)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Commercial Court Registry)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within seven months of the financial year-end (31 July for a 31 December closing); a court-ordered extension of up to three months is available
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Judicial injunction with a coercive penalty of up to EUR 1,500; repeated non-compliance triggers administrative strike-off proceedings (radiation) and the manager's civil liability

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Confirmation annuelle de la situation (annual confirmation of registered particulars and beneficial-owner data)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Commercial Court Registry via the French business registry system)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one calendar month following the anniversary of the company's initial registration date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Registry suspension of certificates and clean-copy extracts; persistent failure triggers striking-off (radiation) and EUR 1,500 court-ordered fines; inaccurate beneficial-owner statements carry a EUR 15,000 fine (EUR 75,000 for legal persons)

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Cotisation Foncière des Entreprises (CFE) — annual local business-premises tax return and payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DGFIP acting for the local collecting authorities (communes and EPCI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Payment due by 15 December of the billing year; the declaration of rental values is embedded in the annual liasse fiscale
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment penalty of 5% of the assessed tax plus 0.4% monthly interest; non-payment exposes the SARL to enforcement procedures and loss of tax-calculation relief for prior years

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: VAT return (CA3) and annual VAT summary (CA12 where simplified filing regime applies)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Monthly CA3 VAT return due by the 19th day of the following month; under the simplified annual regime the CA12 is filed by 19 May of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of 5% of the VAT due and monthly interest of 0.4%; EUR 15,000 fine for repeated omission; no direct strike-off consequence, but the tax authority may notify the registry of a serious filing default

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A French SARL must appoint a statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) when it exceeds at least two of three thresholds at the end of the financial year: total assets above EUR 4,000,000, net turnover above EUR 8,000,000, or an average workforce above 50 employees; the online hydroponics retail entity is presumed below these thresholds and is therefore not statutorily audited
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French local GAAP under the Plan Comptable Général (PCG) incorporated by the Code de commerce; IFRS applies only to consolidated groups and listed entities; small SARLs may use simplified presentation for the annual accounts

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SARL declares beneficial owners (bénéficiaires effectifs) to the registry at incorporation and within 30 days of any change; each annual confirmation annuelle attests that the recorded beneficial-owner data remains accurate; share transfers must be entered in the registre des mouvements de titres immediately, and the annual approval of accounts is conditioned on the correctness of such entries
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors and Managers (Registre de présence et décisions de gérance)
Minute Book for shareholders' meetings and written consultations (Registre des procès-verbaux)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: 550–1,200 USD per annum depending on domiciliation provider in France
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 0 USD below audit thresholds; 6,000–20,000 USD per annum if a mandatory statutory audit is triggered

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced 15% tax rate on the first EUR 42,500 of annual taxable profit for eligible SARL entities with turnover below EUR 10 million, fully paid-up capital, and at least 75% of capital held continuously by individuals; Research Tax Credit (CIR) at 30% of qualifying R&D expenditure up to EUR 100 million (5% above that cap); Innovation Tax Credit (CII) at 20% on qualifying prototype, design, and new-process expenditure; Young Innovative Company (JEI) status granting exemption from corporate income tax for the first three profitable years (applicable to a hydroponics R&D-focused SARL less than 5 years old and exceeding the 15% R&D intensity threshold); no general statutory tax holiday regime exists in France.
